name: Moonmilk
lore: It takes a print from anything that touches it and keeps it. Some of the prints on it are very small.
prompt: Body of soft white cave moonmilk, a wet paste like wet chalk holding a hunched shape, finger marks pressed into its surface where something touched it, thick drips hanging off its underside and a cold pale sheen
